checks.title: Anonymous admin request is recoverable JSON, not redirect or cache
Missing/foreign Origin and spoofed forwarded host are rejected
Malformed JSON, unknown operation, extra fields and media fail closed
Upload larger than five MiB is rejected before import
Only effective workspace administrator roles may bootstrap
Organization membership priority prevents workspace-role elevation
Pack inspection returns safe metadata and rejects invalid pack
Import is atomic, disabled, audited and grants management only
Workspace administrator without course grant cannot read or manage imported course
Idempotent import preserves immutable content; changed content requires version
Last active unscoped manager cannot revoke their own grant
Tenant, program and nested object IDs cannot cross workspace boundary
Management capability does not imply individual review or CSV export
checks.error:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

200 !== 404

checks.title: Scoped manager sees only cohort operations and cannot change global settings or permissions
Batch enrollment rejects a foreign member without partially enrolling valid members
Valid enrollment batch is atomic and idempotent
Enrollment may move before work but scoped manager cannot cross cohorts
Session changes verify object and cohort; M2/M3 cannot open
Enable permits learner work, which immediately prevents enrollment move
Enrollment revoke stops learner writes and reactivation preserves draft
Revoked workspace membership immediately removes manager reads and writes
A manager with revoked membership cannot keep final active manager revocation valid
Concurrent self-revocation leaves exactly one active unscoped manager
Explicit review grant revocation removes access without adding other capabilities
Program disable/enable/close/reopen preserves draft and controls writes
Session close denies work, open restores same attempt, scheduled is server-timed
Settings update is audited and DTO excludes answers, grading and private content
Purge requires exact confirmation, unscoped manager and elapsed retention
Eligible purge deletes only own responses and retains enrollments, audit, other program
